$comment: Harness configuration. Committed. Edit this rather than the hook scripts.
$comment_enforcement: blocking = hooks exit 2 and stop the action. advisory = hooks warn only.
$comment_phase_gate: Restrict source edits by the current phase in state.json. This is what makes 'plan before code' real.
$comment_verify_gate: Block end-of-turn while verification fails. After max_stop_attempts, escalate to the human instead of trapping the session.
$comment_artifact_gate: Refuse to let a pipeline agent stop without writing its artifact and VERDICT block.
$comment_validate_on_write: Format + lint the touched file after each write. Set typecheck_on_write false in large repos where a project-wide tsc is slow.

verify.$comment: Leave a key empty to auto-detect from package.json scripts / go.mod / Cargo.toml.

$comment_protected: Extra glob patterns, relative to the project root, that the pipeline may not write. Secrets and .git are always protected regardless, and unconditionally — protect-paths.sh ignores both `active` and `enforcement` for those.
$comment_test_paths: Extra glob patterns counted as test files during the `test` phase, on top of the built-in conventions (*.test.*, *_test.*, */tests/*, */spec/*, ...). Needed where tests live beside the code: Rust in-file #[test] modules want ["src/**/*.rs"].
$comment_artifact_freshness: Seconds. How recently an agent whose filename isn't predictable (finding-verifier, researcher) must have written for the artifact gate to accept it. Stops a leftover file from an earlier round satisfying the gate.
$comment_tier_thresholds: Risk score cut-offs for .claude/bin/tier.sh. Below `quick` = work directly, no pipeline. Lower them to route more work through review; raise them if the pipeline fires on changes that don't need it.
$comment_auto_advance: Advance state.json `phase` automatically when an agent lands a valid artifact. Only ever runs after the artifact gate passes, so it can't advance through a failed gate. Turn off to drive phases by hand.
$comment_backstop_threshold: Distinct source files a session may change with no run active before the user-level backstop (~/.claude/hooks/harness-backstop.sh) interrupts once and suggests /build-pipeline. Raise it if you do a lot of ad-hoc work here; `touch .harness/.bypass` disables it for this repo entirely.
$comment_max_rounds: Review -> revise cycles before escalating to the human. Loops that can't converge in three rounds usually have a plan problem, not a code problem.
